label: File Download
description: A Download File logic node that saves any string to the user's machine as a real file — Blob + object URL, fully client-side, no dependencies. Wire To CSV's CSV output into Content, send Download, and get Done or Failure + Error. Filename and MIME Type inputs (text/plain default; use text/csv or application/json). Ships a demo component: Static Data → To CSV → Download File behind a button.
